end.title: End {name}?
end.body: PID {pid}. Unsaved data will be lost.

body.one: {count} process of {name} will be ended. Unsaved data will be lost.
body.other: All {count} processes of {name} will be ended. Unsaved data will be lost.

endTree.title: End the process tree of {name}?

body.one: PID {pid} and its child process will be ended. Unsaved data will be lost.
body.other: PID {pid} and its {count} child processes will be ended. Unsaved data will be lost.

endTree.bodyAlone: PID {pid} has no child processes. Only this process will be ended.

partial.one: Ended {count} process; {failed} couldn't be ended (access denied or already exited).
partial.other: Ended {count} processes; {failed} couldn't be ended (access denied or already exited).

error.accessDenied: Couldn't end {name}: access denied. Turn on the privileged service in Settings, or run Argus as administrator. Protected processes may still not end.
error.critical: {name} is a critical system process. Ending it would crash Windows, so the action was blocked.

priority.confirmBody: Realtime processes run ahead of system tasks. If one uses all processor time, the mouse and keyboard may stop responding.
priority.downgraded: Realtime priority needs administrator rights, so High was set instead.

partial.one: Changed the priority of {count} process; {failed} couldn't be changed (access denied or already exited).
partial.other: Changed the priority of {count} processes; {failed} couldn't be changed (access denied or already exited).

on.failed: Couldn't turn on Efficiency mode for {name}

partial.one: Turned on Efficiency mode for {count} process; {failed} couldn't be changed (access denied or already exited).
partial.other: Turned on Efficiency mode for {count} processes; {failed} couldn't be changed (access denied or already exited).

off.failed: Couldn't turn off Efficiency mode for {name}

partial.one: Turned off Efficiency mode for {count} process; {failed} couldn't be changed (access denied or already exited).
partial.other: Turned off Efficiency mode for {count} processes; {failed} couldn't be changed (access denied or already exited).

copyFailed: Couldn't access the clipboard, so the {what} wasn't copied.

failed.accessDenied: {what}: administrator rights are required. Run Argus as administrator and try again.

staleProcess: The process information is out of date. Refresh and try again.
